recognize_zh: 四格血片中多顆淋巴樣細胞周圍緊密環繞著一圈紫色血小板（血小板衛星現象），連脫落的淡藍色細胞質碎片（C、D 圖）也被血小板包圍，而旁邊的中性球則沒有，說明這是黏附在腫瘤淋巴細胞上的假性血小板減少。
features: Platelets rosetting tightly around the surface of lymphoid cells (panels A-C), forming satellitism
Platelet rosettes also surround detached pale blue cytoplasmic fragments without nuclei (panels C and D)
Lymphoid cells medium-to-large with round to oval nuclei, fairly condensed chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Adjacent segmented neutrophil (panel B) and other leukocytes lack attached platelets
Few free platelets in the background, explaining a spuriously low automated platelet count
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, condensed chromatin and a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm. Numerous platelets adhere tightly around these lymphoid cells (platelet satellitism), and similar platelet rosettes surround detached anucleate cytoplasmic fragments derived from the neoplastic cells. A neighboring neutrophil lacks adherent platelets, and free platelets are sparse in the background. Findings represent platelet satellitism around neoplastic lymphocytes and their cytoplasmic fragments, a cause of pseudothrombocytopenia; platelet count should be verified by smear review or a citrated sample.

ddx.vs: Classic EDTA satellitism rosettes around neutrophils, whereas here platelets adhere to lymphoid cells and their fragments while the neutrophil is spared.
Clumping forms free platelet aggregates not centered on a leukocyte, whereas satellitism rings a cell or fragment.
Azurophilic or basophilic granules lie within the cell cytoplasm, while satellite platelets sit on the outer cell membrane as separate discrete particles.

ddx.dx: True thrombocytopenia with circulating lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia persists on a citrated sample and smear shows no platelets sequestered around cells.
